runtime_uncertainties: Abstract narrow-road and reverse-vehicle construction calls plus original motion measurement are CPU-tested. Concrete Native adapter, source capture, exact compatibility and saved-processing proofs remain CPU work. Reasonable safety and interference require independent physical/legal review.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed the frozen exact law, cell, accepted-evidence inventory, original source terms and the exact controlled Native case constructions. No accepted recordings are supplied; each selected case targets the uncovered backing judgment branch with fixed physical comparisons.

gaps.requirement: No accepted recordings are supplied for this assignment. The exact text, selected branch, exceptions, timing and source observations still require a finite controlled case comparison and an executable delivery package.
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The exported accepted-evidence inventory does not demonstrate the listed full-text coverage; new cases or source-backed existing-evidence equivalence must be prepared.

full_text_branch_inventory.branch: Backward vehicle motion with reasonable safety and no interference with other traffic.
Compare controlled opposing-traffic/no-conflict conditions and interference conditions while maintaining reverse maneuver.
Reasonable safety is a judgment phrase without a statutory numeric cutoff.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: The driver shall not back unless the movement can be made with reasonable safety and without interfering with other traffic.
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Original reverse and other-traffic motion require a selected exact case.

coverage.subject: ego full body and reversing path

limitations: Original pixels must be reviewed for subject/other full-body visibility after Native capture.

drv.backing.evidence: Reverse gear readback and displacement measured from original 20 Hz backing history and trace.

drv.time_to_conflict.evidence: Original relative positions and speed for an external time-to-conflict analysis; no legal cutoff encoded.

rel.surface_gap.evidence: Original full-body vertices and actor positions support a later surface-gap calculation; center distance is diagnostic only.

drv.hard_deceleration.evidence: Other-vehicle original speed sequence supports measured braking response. No hard-deceleration threshold is encoded.

ru.pedestrian.evidence: Original synchronized RGB views allow review for persons in the reversing path; none is presumed present.

rel.bearing.evidence: Original ego and other positions plus four views support relative bearing calculation and visual cross-check.

rel.contact.evidence: Original participant body vertices and full RGB sources support later contact review; no collision finding is made.
